explanation: The local form of the commutative Auslander–Reiten conjecture: over a commutative Noetherian local ring, a f.g. M with Ext^i(M, R) = Ext^i(M, M) = 0 for i > 0 is free. Since f.g. projective modules over a local ring are free, this is equivalent to the commutative conjecture restricted to local rings, which is the usual form in the literature (e.g. Huneke–Leuschke, Kimura arXiv:2304.03956); the general case reduces to it by localisation. Faithful.
